tools.name: choose_route
tools.description: Free decision step. Call this FIRST, before you search the web, reason a check out yourself, or pay any route. Input is one plain-language sentence about what you are about to look up or verify (for example "validate a German IBAN before a transfer" or "is 2028 a leap year"). Returns JSON with decis

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: Free catalog. Returns every paid route as a JSON array with path, HTTP method, url, price in USDC, what it checks, its limits and what unpaid and unknown input do (HTTP 402 and HTTP 404 without charge). Takes no arguments. Use it when choose_route said skip but you want to browse, or to see all bund

tools.name: describe_route
tools.description: Free detail lookup for exactly one paid route. Input is the route path such as /iban or /transfer; the result is a JSON object with its price in USDC, parameters it needs, what it checks, limits and 402/404 behavior. Returns a short error text "Unknown route ... Call list_routes" if the path does no

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_routes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List paid fact routes, prices, and limits. Does not call them and does not spend USDC." → after: "Free catalog. Returns every paid route as a JSON array with path, HTTP method, url, price in USDC, what it checks, its limits and what unpaid and unknown input do (HTTP 402 and HTTP 404 without charge). Takes no arguments. Use it when choose_route said skip but you want to browse, or to see all bund"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
